Client Cache Layer Behavior (App)
- Image loader: ImprovedTokenLogoCacheManager (see: app/src/main/java/net/xian/xianwalletapp/data/ImprovedTokenLogoCacheManager.kt)
  Before change: respectCacheHeaders=false (server validators ignored).
  After change: respectCacheHeaders=true and OkHttp HTTP cache enabled (20 MB), enabling deterministic ETag/Last-Modified revalidation.
- UI usages: AsyncImage calls primarily rely on Coil; local assets/drawables bypass HTTP.

Conclusions
- All tested remote origins correctly support HTTP validators (ETag or Last-Modified) and return 304 to conditional requests.
- With app change to honor headers and enable OkHttp cache, CDN validator behavior will be utilized consistently.
- Local assets/drawables are immutable and do not require HTTP caching.

Trace Method
- Tools: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest HEAD/GET; conditional headers If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since.
